All elements of the expected output are substantively present and well-matched.

But reviewing more carefully, RDS automated backups retention is mentioned elsewhere (7-day backups) as already in place, but not explicitly tied to the read replica recommendation as a bad-writes caveat. Given the strict wording of the assertion requiring this for every instance, the cross-Region read replica omission is a gap.
